labels_rule.entries: one entry per directory directly under cache/ or runs/ (its path ends in /) and per file directly in cache/ or runs/, for each one that holds at least one path of manifest.tsv or excluded.tsv; files counts those paths
labels_rule.path_rule: a path component build-<digits> of an inventory path names that Excel build; its source is the directory up to that component
labels_rule.path_only_rule: a run folder is read from its path only when its name starts with w108 or w109, ignoring case (the W108/W109 identification runs that the infra-m0.5 reading rule keeps closed), or when an entry of modules or classes in migration/numeric-provenance.json with disposition tainted or unresolved selects one of its files as the OxFunc path smart-fuzzer/<path> (a module by its path; a class by its selector's paths, or by its prefixes and suffixes together) or names smart-fuzzer/runs/<folder> in any of its strings. Such a folder is labelled by the path rule alone and none of its files is opened; path_only lists each one with every reason that applies
labels_rule.metadata_rule: every other entry also reads each of its JSON files (inventory paths ending in .json) at any depth below the entry, from the local originals. Only top-level metadata fields are read: excel_build of the document object, and build and excel_build of its objects excel_environment, environment, version_axes and profile, of capture_provenance.environment, of environment.excel, and of each object in its array environments. A value is a build when it is a string of ASCII digits or a non-negative integer; the version fields (16.0) name no build and are not read. A file whose text does not hold build" holds no such field and is not parsed; a file that is not a JSON object contributes nothing; capture rows are never read
labels_rule.unread_rule: a JSON file of such an entry that is empty, holds NUL bytes, is not UTF-8, or holds the text build" and does not parse is listed in unread_metadata with its reason and holds_build_key: whether a key build or excel_build with a build value appears anywhere in its text, searched with NUL bytes dropped so that UTF-16 text is searched too. A listed file with holds_build_key true would hide a label, and the infra-m0.6 case fails on it
labels_rule.outside_rule: an entry that is not path-only and has no source at all is searched in the text of its JSON and JSONL files for a key build or excel_build with a build value at any nesting; each one found is listed in builds_outside_rule with those files and builds. It stays unknown, the conservative label, because its build sits outside the permitted fields (for example in the capture_provenance of each row of a top-level array), and the list counts it. Bead dc-h9au owns the decision whether a per-row capture build may label such an entry
labels_rule.label: known when the path rule and the metadata rule give exactly one build, with each source listed; unknown when they give none, or more than one (then listed in conflicting_builds)
labels_rule.certification: certifies_exact_target is excel-build-<build> for a known entry, the only Exact target that entry can serve as acquisition evidence for, and null for an unknown entry, which cannot certify any Exact target (plan section 10.2). The label is only the acquisition precondition: any certification still needs the raw Value2 bits and settings that plan section 10.1 asks for
